# casdoor_invitation (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor invitation, the code that lets users sign up to an application.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_invitation" "beta" {
  owner        = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name         = "beta"
  display_name = "Beta testers"
  code         = "acme-beta-2026"
  quota        = 100
  application  = casdoor_application.portal.name
  state        = "Active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the invitation, unique within its owner.
- `owner` (String) The organization that the object belongs to.

### Optional

- `application` (String) The application that the invitation is for, or `All`.
- `code` (String) The invitation code, which can be a regular expression that matches several codes.
- `default_code` (String) The code filled in on the sign-up page when `code` is a regular expression.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `email` (String) The email that the invited user must sign up with.
- `expire_time` (String) The time when the invitation expires, in the RFC 3339 format.
- `phone` (String) The phone number that the invited user must sign up with.
- `quota` (Number) The number of times the invitation can be used.
- `signup_group` (String) The group that the invited users are added to.
- `state` (String) The state, e.g. `Active`.
- `username` (String) The username that the invited user must sign up with.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the invitation was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the invitation in the `owner/name` format.
- `used_count` (Number) The number of times the invitation has been used.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the organization and the name.
terraform import casdoor_invitation.example <organization>/<name>
```
